about: Dated maps of the Battle of Verdun the sector editor lays over the ground. Each is a scan kept in the asset library (.asset-cache/battle-maps, fetched by pnpm map:battle-maps), fitted to the ground by its control points: a pixel of the scan, and where that place lies in Lambert-93 metres. The frame is the part of the scan that is map, in pixels; what lies outside it (margins, the legend) is left off.

maps.title: Fronts français successifs au nord de Verdun, 21 au 26 février 1916
maps.source: Les armées françaises dans la Grande Guerre, tome IV, 1er volume, carte n° 16 (1:20 000)
maps.credit: Site Mémoire des hommes, ministère des Armées
